guidanceConsulted.query: responsive reference documentation page with data tables that do not overflow on mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Lean on intrinsic sizing; give scrollable treatment (overflow:auto) to long unbreakable content; wrap wide tables in an overflow container rather than letting them force page overflow.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: .table-wrap{overflow-x:auto} around the doc-table; overflow-wrap:anywhere on table cells, h1, and lede; 32% first column with 7.5rem min-width (house stub pattern shared with v153/joint-iteration).

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible inline code and long token wrapping in documentation prose
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use semantic HTML (real table headers, list markup, discernible link text) and let text wrap rather than clipping; reserve nowrap treatments for content that genuinely must not break.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: th scope=row on every quick-reference row header, real ul for references, every link's accessible name states its target (no ambiguous labels), no white-space:nowrap anywhere — long flag/URL tokens wrap via overflow-wrap:anywhere instead of overflowing.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Search results returned ids prevent-text-wrapping / improve-text-layout-and-legibility / html / accessibility; the wrap-don't-clip and semantic-structure recommendations were applied, the nowrap pattern deliberately not used.
